item.tib: tshe sgrab 'od dkar dpag med kyi tshogs mchod zad med chu gter
item.coloph: de ltar 'chi med tshe ru sgrab pa'i tshogs kyi yan lag zad med bdud rtsi'i chu gter 'di yang / rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi thugs bcud/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi gsang lung / 'chi med tshe ru sgrub pa'i yang bcud 'di yang / 'chi med gtsug phud kyis gshen gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan nas rim gyis brgyud de/ bla chen dran pas kyang rgyas 'bring rim par phyes nas grol thob brgyad la gdam (gdams)/ gter kha cha gnyis sbas pa'i lung bstan rim gyis thob nas/ dgongs pa thun mong chig dril du 'dug phyir/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung dang / gtsan rgyal rdo rje 'bar bas dus bab kyi yig ris dngos phul bzhin/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'bring 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po bdag la/ skye ba sngon gyi lha skal zab mor phog pa'i snying bu shes rab phun tshogs nas*/ sngon kyi (gyi) las kyi 'phro sad nas bskur (bskul) ba dang*/ ma zad bla chung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dang / yul mi dad sbyin sogs kyis bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas/ shar grol smin gling du dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'dis kyang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
